tei:div.tei:p: oṃ swa sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa rnams kyis mkha' 'gro thams cad pa'i gtor ma chen po byed par 'dod pas/ rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las 'byung ba'i lugs 'di bya ste/ lū dril nag gsum sogs kun dang*/ khyad par du yang nag po spyod pa pa'i lugs dang shin tu 'brel ba yin no/ /de yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bya ba'am rdul tshon nam chu tshon gyis chos 'byung gi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa rim pa gsum/ zlum skor rim pa gsum le tshe nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa byas kyang rung*/ zlum skor nang ma'i dbus su re mig dgur bya/ dbus su dri bzang dang khrag gis zlum por bya/ re mig brgyad la lha'i mdog dang mthun pa'am/ sngon po lta bu ji ltar 'os pa'i tshom bu lnga lnga bkod/ re mig nyi shu rtsa bzhi la yang tshom bu gnyis gnyis 'god do/ /rdul mtshon gyis bri ba ma lcogs na khrag gam tsan+dan dmar po'i maṇ+ḍal lam/ chos 'byung gi dbus su maṇ+ḍal phal pa tshom bu tsam bkod pas kyang rung ngo*/ /rgyun gyi nyams len la shin tu bsdu na ting nge 'dzin kho nas kyang rung bas/ gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi phyi ru 'dus byas pa med kyang chog go /gtor ma gcig kho na yin na maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun dang*/ gnyis yod na 'das gtor maṇ+ḍal gyi byang shar dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma shar lhor 'god/ bzhi yod na phyogs bzhi dang*/ brgyad yod na phyogs mtshams dang*/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa yod na de'i rim pas 'god do/ /mchod yon mdun dang mchod pa gzhan rnams g.yas g.yon du bshams/ sgrub thabs las 'byung ba'i mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ gtor ma byin rlabs dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan 'dren pa rnams byas la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho sa ma s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan lnga dang*/

oṃ ka ra ka ra= sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dngos bstan la/ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ/ dang por byas pa'i sngags de yod kyang*/ rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor la sbyor ba'i tshe dkyus bzhin mdzad do/ / ar+ghaṃ/ la sogs pa dang*/ nang mchod dang*/ oṃ bī ni badz+ra ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sogs rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang brgyud kyi bstod pa dang*/ srid dang zhi ba/ sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/ hūṃ rnams las byung ba'i 'jig rten skyong ba/ k+ṣe tra pā la brgyad mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa dang*/ k+ṣeṃ rnams las byung ba'i gnas bsrung zhing skyong nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams 'khor dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas pa pheṃ/ oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*/ /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dabs dang lam dang 。zhing*/ /khyad par du ni khang stong dang*/ /snod dang thang dang sa stong dang*/ /khyad par chu la gnas pa yi/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ /lhas sbyin mnyam du brten pa dang*/ /nag po gtsigs dang 'jigs byed dang*/ /dga' las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byad ma dang drag mo dang*/ /'jigs byed lha mo u mas bstod/ /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal nyid dang*/ /mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma ste rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo/ /bcu gsum dbang phyug ma dang ni/ /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jib byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma/ / drag mo'i gzugs can gzugs chen mo/ /mche ba gtsigs dang thod can ma/ /thod phreng phreng can kha ṭ+wāṃ ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra s+t+wa can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi de nyid che/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed pa/

/sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal po che/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen te/ /rdul med rnal 'byor 'byin pa mo/ /rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad kun nas 'dir spyon cig /oṃ kak+ka dha na/ bab+bhan+dha na/ khakh+kha da na/ sarba duṣ+taḥnaṃ ha na ha na/ gha gha gha ta na/ che ge mo/ shin+taṃ ku ru hūṃhūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswāhā/ zhes spyan drangs/ so so'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ dbang ldan du nag po drag po sku mdog dkar ba/ rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rgan byad ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ shar du drag po chen po ser po glang po che la zhon pa/ rdo rje dang gdan la gnon pa/ rgyal ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ mer lhas sbyin dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ hom gzar dang*/ dbyug gu gsum pa dang*/ ba dan dang*/ spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ nag mo bzang mo la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ lhor nag po sngon po ma he la zhon pa/ dbyug pa dang mdung 'dzin pa/ zla ba mo la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ lho nub gtsigs byed sngo nag mi ro la zhon pa/ ral gri dang phub chung 'dzin pa/ mar me la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ nub tu mi sdug pa dkar po chu srin la zhon pa/ zhags pa thogs pa/ drag mo'i gzugs la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ rlung du dga' ba las 'das pa nag po ri dwags la zhon pa/ ba dan thogs pa/ thod phreng ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ byang du log 'dren ser po gnod sbyin mi'i gzugs can la zhon pa/ lcags kyu dang rin po che'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ ral gri ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ gtso bo brgyad po rnams ni rang mtshungs kyi yum gyis 'khyud pa/ phyag bzhi'i 'og ma gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar bas bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa/ 'khor rnams thams cad rang rang gi gtso bo dang 'dra ba las/ ral gri ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ma ni ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan can dang*/ gzhu can ma snying gar 'khyud rgya mdzad

pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ngo bo khor yug gsum la phyogs g.yon bskor dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis gnas pa ni/ drag tu rgod par shing mchog ka dam pa/ zhing <'gos 'gyur du/ yum zhi gdong dang*/ yab dril chen du'ang bshad/> skyong zhi gdong dril bu chen mor bcas/ /rdo rje 'dzin zhing 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas/ /kol+la gi rir ri rtse la brten pa'i/ /zhing skyong me zhal dpal chen mo dang bcas/ /mi mgo 'dzin zhing mi ro'i gdan la gnas/ /bha ra ṇa yul tā la'i shing la brten/ gtsigs <bde byed ma dang sgra byen zer/> pa chen po skra gyen 'bar mar bcas/ rtse gsum <g.yas pa'i mtshon cha zer/> 'dzin zhing sid+dhi/ sim+ba ṭi <dngul chu'i gang ba'i snod/> /de wi ko ṭi ra shing mchog bā ṭa la/ /lus <rgyu can yang zer/> chen po ni rna ba chen mor bcas/ /mdung thung 'dzin zhing yi dwags gdan la bzhugs/ /bi ra dza ra ni a mra la brten pa'i/ /ha har <skad dod a bhi yod zer/> bzhad pa yum ni me 'bar ma/ /ba dan 'dzin zhing shing leb la gnas pa'o/ /e ruṃ ḍa ru kaṃr+ṇ+ṇa'i shing gi drung*/ /dril bu'i sgra can me yi gdong ma gnyis/ /rdo rje shaka <'phang mdung zer/> ti 'dzin zhing phag la zhon/ /ser <tata phur/> skya'i gnas su shing mchog dza ṭi <ti zer/> byin pa chen po dmar ser ma dang bcas/ /gtun shing 'dzin zhing yi dwags gdan la bzhugs/ /e la'i grong du a pa ra dzi ti'i shing*/ /glang po'i rna ba stobs chen ma dang bcas/ /zhags pa thogs pas bong bu'i steng du bzhugs/ kha che'i yul du ri bo la brten pa'i/ /'jigs <sbu gu'i byin pa can zer rtsa ba'i byin can yang zer/> byed chen po ba lang rna ba ma/ /lag na lcags sgrogs nor sbyin gdan la bzhugs/ /ma rung mya ngam thang la brten pa yi/ /gtsigs <rim pa mo yang zer/> pa'i zhal can 'jigs zhal <skad dod ga ta la zer ba yod zer/> ma lhan cigalcags kyu zhags pa thogs shing ma he zhon/

/spa shing ldum ra la brten na ga rar/ /mche <spu'i byin pa/> gtsigs chen po ro langs can mar bcas/ /thong gshol 'dzin zhing mi mgo'i gdan la bzhugs/ /puṇ+ḍa wer+dhar a shwad tha yi drung*/ /bum pa'i 'bras bu can dang tsa <kum+bha ṇ+ḍi zer/> muṇ+ḍī kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin mi ro'i gdan la 'gying*/ /dza yan+ti ru khang pa brtsegs pa la/ /ral <'ug gdong ma > pa gsum pa bzhin mdzes <bzhin dngas ma zer/> ma dang bcas/ /lug rgyud 'dzin zhing keng rus la gnas pa/ pre ta pu praṣ+ta pu nga zer ba'ang yod/ ri ra u dūṃ ba ra la/ /'jigs par byed pa glog gi <dril bu'i sgra zer 'ug gdong yang zer/> gdong mar bcas/ /gzhal yas khang gnas dbyug pa mdung thung 'dzin/ /su ba rar ni shal ma li yi nags/ /kun mdzes dang ni me lce'i gdong ma gnyis/ /sha chen phung por gri gug mdung thung 'dzin/ /tsā ri tra ru ka rañja shing la/ /dril bu chen po ka rañjar gnas ma/ /mdung thung 'dzin zhing 'jam 'bras sdong por gnas/ /o ṭ+yan <o tre yang zer/> yul du mya ngan med pa'i shing*/ /zhing skyong <drag po stobs chen/> sgra can yum ni lha chen mo/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin zhing 'dre bdud mnan/ /dza lan dha rar gser shing la brten pa'i/ /zhing skyong bskyed <mig skyes yang zer/> pa zhes bya gtum mor bcas/ /gri gug 'dzin zh-ing mi <bdud mnan par byas kyang chog3gt; ro zhabs kyis mnan/ /k+ṣi ra ka ru sā la'i shing sdong la/ /ri rab chen po 'jig rten ma mor bcas/ /ral gri 'phyar zhing me dpung la gnas pa/ /mā ya pu rir shā ṣo ṭa shing drung*/ /zhing skyong 'jigs pa 'dod pa mo dang bcas/ /mi ro'i phung por rdo rje shaka ti 'dzin/ /am+b+rai ka yul de ba <dhā dri zer/> da ru la/ /brtul zhugs chen po srul mo dang lhan cig/thong gshol ga ya <ga da'i dbyug pa zer thor ba dang dbyug pa'ang zer/> 'dzin zhing seng ge zhon/ /rgyal po'i khab tu ne li

<da li ka zer lha rten gyi shing gcig yin zer > ke shing la/ rga ba chen po mi sdug ma dang bcas/ /rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin zhing 'khor lor gnas/ /bod yul brag gi phug la brten pa yi/ /zhing skyong longs spyod lhan cig skyes mar bcas/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin zhing yi dwags mnan/ /mā la bar ni sbrang rtsi'i shing gi drung*/ /sna <skyes pa'i zer > tshogs dbang phyug dbang bskur ma dang bcas/ /ro gdan la bzhugs rdo rje tho ba 'dzin/ /kun kyang las dang mthun pa'i nyams 'gyur dang*/ /rgyan dang na bza' kha dog 'od zer 'bar/ /yang na phyogs dang mthun pa'i kha dog bcas/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun gyis bskor bar 'gyur/ /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid 'khor lo'i rtsibs sam re mig so so la bzhugs pa'o/ / ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ sum+bha 'i mthar/ oṃ sarba k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wa ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag zhing skyong thams cad la lhan cig tu gtor ma 'bul te/ lag pa g.yon gtor snod snying gar 'dzin tshul dang*/ g.yas sdigs mdzub gtor ma la bstan te/ oṃ bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa sarba yo ga yo gi shwa rī hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswāhā/ zhes pa bdun la sogs pas 'bul/ man rnye las 'di ye shes dbang phyug ma kho nas gtor sngags su bshad pa ni saṃ pu ṭa dang rang rkang gi dbang du byas pa'o/ / oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa dzaḥswāhā/ zhes pas kyang lha grangs dang mnyam pa sogs lan mang du 'bul zhing*/ mthar/ oṃ kha kha/ nas/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā 'i bar mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags lan gsum nas bdun gyi bar du phul/ ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod phul/ spro na zhabs bsil phyag phyis so rtsi sogs mchod pa gzhan yang mang du bstabs/ gang ltar yang mthar rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ shing gcig dang ni/ nas/ gos med sbyor ba skyed byed ma/

/rdo rje dbang mo 'khor dang bcas/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing rnams la/ /rab dgas zhing skyong rig mar bcas/ /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad 'byung po yi/ /tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ /lha'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ ces pa'i bar brjod/ las so so'i dmigs bsal yod na las la bskul ba yang byas te gtor ma phyir btang ngo*/ /yig brgya bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ sogs bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can/ sogs kyi mthar/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhagagayas sa la reg ste/ oṃ at+ma tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho ྅haṃ/ rnam lnga 'dod skor bya/ oṃ sarba duṣ+ta gṛh+ṇa gṛh+na gats+tsha hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra muḥ zhes 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs/ dkyil 'khor pa bdag la bsdu'o/ /de nas bdag bsrung ba dang*/ mtshams rngam dang bstod pa rnams bya zhing*/ smon lam gdab/ bkra shis kyang bya'o/ /yang nag po drag po la sogs pa kho na bkod na/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i gtor ma zhes bya zhing*/ zhing skyong nyer bzhi kho na bkod na gnas srung gis gtor ma zhes bya la/ de gnyis sdom pa ni/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rgyas pa'am/ zhing skyong gi gtor chog chen mo zhes bya'o/ /yang hūṃ mdzad 'byung po 'dul ba gtso bor byas pa'i gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen por grags pa gzhan yang yod pa/ re zhig 'dir ma bris te logs su 'bri bar bya'o/ /zhes pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga'i yan lag tu mkho ba 'di ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las 'byung ba ltar/ gtor chog mdo tsam smos pa ste/ 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// //'dir sngar gyi gtor dpe dang ngag sgros tsam la ma bzhag par/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro rtsa 'grel 'gyur mi gcig pa gsum dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'di skor gyi rtsa 'grel dang*/

man rnye sogs la zhib tu brtags te zhus dag kyang byas pa'o/ /bkra shis/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/mkha' 'gro'i spyi gtor rgyas pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 358-PAGE 357--PAGE 351-
